tei:div.tei:p: bskang gso rgyas pa gtong lugs ni/ sems bskyed sdom chog tshul khrims rnam dag gzungs yan/ le'u bdun bgo 'don byas na chog hrīḥsngon= tshul khrims dri ldan= rig 'dzin 'dus pa lta bu bsnyen bstod yan/ thugs rje chen po/ yum bka'/ dpal chen/ rta khyung*/ spro na gnam chos/ rang nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang= ma ṇi a yu= dang*/ rgyal byams lha lnga/ mtshan brgyad gcig dril/ gur drag gsang sgrub nas/ seng gdong yan/ dam can spyi gtor mgor spro na byin rlabs rol mtsho ltar/ sngags 'bul bstod pa mang ba'am/ rang gzhung*/ rig 'dzin dga' ston dang*/ bla ma yi dam= rgyas bsdus gang mos/ ma mgon lcam dral dbu nas/ skong ba mthar/ 'khrugs skong*/ phud bshal/ mnga' gsol/ bstod pa/ phrin bcol/ legs ldan/ dpal chen thugs las= ma ning*/ tshogs bdag mdung 'dzin/ brag lha zhal bzhi/ phyag bzhi/ gnod sbyin/ sngags srung*/ srog sgrub/ dud sol/ zhing skyong*/ lha chen/ dur bdag dur khrod lha mo/ rta lha/ dzam la/ tshe ring ma/ gza'/ dur khrod rab 'jigs= bcas/ dam can spu gri/ btsan/ phyogs phyogs= ma/ rgyas par dbang drag dus kyi pho nya/ thang lha/ spom ra/ g.yu sgron/ ngom rgyal/ klu rgyal bcas/ spro na na rag skong bshags smon lam bcas/ tshogs byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren/ (462) mchod bshags bsgral gsum/ skong bshags rdo rje'i thol glu/ mdor na rab 'byams= drang ba/ bsam lhun/ lhag ma/ dam can spyi gtor 'gugs pa nas bkra shis yan/ dkar gtor/ rtsa rgyud/ bskul pa/ chad brtan bro/ las byang mchod bstod/ dngos grub/ nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis/ bzang spyod sogs bya'o// ༈ rgyun gsol la zung zad rgyas pa'i/ tshig bdun/ 'dzam gling= sogs/ rig 'dzin skyabs sems yan/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor/ byin 'bebs/ mchod rlabs/ rta khyung 'bar ba/ bsnyen pa brgya/ bsdu ldang*/ hoḥ chu las chu bar= tshig bzhi/ dam can spyi gtor nas byin rlabs nas/

bstod pa yan/ rig 'dzin dga' ston/ bla ma yi dam= gang mos gcig ma mgon lcam dral dbu/ skong ba gsum brgya bcu bdun/ 'khrugs skong phud bshal/ mnga' gsol/ bstod pa/ phrin las/ legs ldan/ tshogs bdag gza'/ dur khrod= ma gsum/ gnod sbyin/ srog sgrub/ tshe ring ma/ bde chen chos sku'i= gsum/ g.yang 'gugs/ rgyal dbang= sngags nyer gcig g.yu sgron/ dur khrod lha mo/ 'jig rten 'phrul gyi= sngags gsum/ hūm̐ḥ dur khrod= btsan/ phyogs phyogs= ma/ skong ba bcas/ rta lha/ thang lha/ spom ra bcas/ gter gzhi gnyis/ gser skyems/ spro na/ bdud rtsi kun khyab bam/ yaṃ bskang gnyis/ ye shes las grub= tshangs pa mgrin sngon= thub pa'i bstan pa= dam can spyi gtor 'gugs (463) pa nas bkra shis yan bya'o// ༈ de las bsdu na/ bdag bskyed bsdu ldang*/ gtor bsngos rig 'dzin dga' ston/ bla ma yi dam= gang mos/ ma mgon dbu nas/ skong ba bdun/ spro na/ 'khrugs skong*/ phud bshal/ mnga' gsol/ bstod pa/ phrin bcol/ legs ldan nas/ spom ra yan sngar ltar/ gser skyems/ yaṃ bskang gnyis/ ye shes/ tshangs pa mgrin sngon= kun bzang zhi khro= thub pa'i= sangs rgyas bstan srung= sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba= ༈ de las shin tu bsdus pa la'ang*/ bdag bskyed skyabs saims tsam dang*/ mchod rlabs/ rta khyung bsnyen pa/ bsdu ldang*/ gtor bsngos gcig ma mgon dbu nas/ skong ba gsum/ bstod/ phrin las/ gza'/ tshe ring gzhung rgyug dur khrod lha mo/ btsan/ phyogs phyogs= ma/ gser skyems/ thub pa'i bstan pa= sangs rgyas bstan srung= bcas kyis grub bo// dge'o//
